entries.name: Atlantic North Equatorial Current
entries.existing_scope: Atlantic Ocean westward North Equatorial Current under the NOAA glossary basin convention. The qualified label is editorial. Dimensions, layer bounds, current axis and annual envelopes require separate evidence. This is distinct from the existing cross-basin family, countercurrents, undercurrents and regional branches.
entries.planning_basis: Named basin identity and geographic context do not define an observed axis, endpoints, layer or current footprint.
entries.next_action: Review basin-specific alongflow continuity, layer and endpoints before an editorial route or physical length.
entries.strategy_next_action: Review basin-specific axes and endpoints; do not infer coordinates or current length from a name.
